title: Product units in gated recurrent networks enhance prediction of nuclear masses and charge radii
abstract: arXiv:2611.18066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The prediction of nuclear properties using machine learning can complement theoretical models and advance the exploration of poorly known domains of the nuclear chart. We propose a machine learning technique for predicting nuclear masses and charge radii based on gated recurrent units (GRU) that integrates learnable product-unit mappings into the candidate state to model multiplicative dependencies among neighboring nuclei. Computations are performed in the complex domain to jointly capture amplitude and phase dynamics. Across three data partitions and three training seeds per partition, AM-PU-GRU achieves a mean mass interpolation RMSE of 0.2698 MeV and a temporal RMSE of 0.1905 MeV. Configuration comparisons support the integration of learned products into gated recurrence. translated_title: 门控循环网络中的乘积单元提升原子核质量与电荷半径的预测
translated_abstract: 使用机器学习预测原子核性质可以补充理论模型，并推动对核素图中知之甚少区域的探索。我们提出了一种基于门控循环单元（GRU）的机器学习技术来预测原子核质量和电荷半径，该技术将可学习的乘积单元映射集成到候选状态中，以建模相邻原子核之间的乘性依赖关系。计算在复数域中进行，以联合捕捉幅度和相位动力学。在三个数据划分及每个划分的三个训练种子上，AM-PU-GRU 取得了 0.2698 MeV 的平均质量插值 RMSE 和 0.1905 MeV 的时间外推 RMSE。配置对比实验支持将学习到的乘积整合进门控循环结构。在不使用质量输入的情况下，MI-PU-GRU 预测电荷半径的 RMSE 为 0.019947 fm，比固定的 WS* 先验低 14.40%。匹配的半径对照实验进一步揭示了候选……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将可学习的乘积单元嵌入门控循环网络并在复数域中进行计算，从而显著提升了原子核质量与电荷半径的预测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes embedding learnable product units into gated recurrent networks with complex-domain computation, significantly enhancing the prediction accuracy of nuclear masses and charge radii.
